exposure: Knowledge of pelvic floor muscle exercises (PFMEs)
Affiliation to school of medicine and health
outcome: Overall knowledge score of the pelvic floor
cohort: The cohort consisted of 938 female university students registered at University College Cork, Ireland for the academic year 2018 to 2019, with 792 included in the final analysis.
finding: Knowledge of the pelvic floor in female university students was generally poor (mean score 9.57 out of 15), with a significant difference in knowledge between students in the school of medicine and health and those in other schools.
